name: Ray of Frost — "if enchanted creature is red" is a condition, not a colour change
notes: Memory: project_cant_rules_and_goaded_as_traits_2026-10-13 (follow-up). colorSetRegex read "When this Aura enters, if enchanted creature is red, tap it" as "<subject> is red" and made every permanent red. A subject with if / when / as long as / unless / while in it is now a condition. Same for the Ring cycle ("if it's white"), Zealots en-Dal, Penumbra Umbra, Selective Obliteration.
